events.title: Grocery Outlet Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates Despite Weak Comps
events.body: Grocery Outlet beats Q1 estimates. Shares surge after hours as traffic improves and the 2026 outlook remains unchanged.

events.title: Earnings Estimates Moving Higher for Darling (DAR): Time to Buy?
events.body: Darling Ingredients (DAR) shares have started gaining and might continue moving higher in the near term, as indicated by solid earnings estimate revisions.

events.title: B&G Foods Q1 Earnings Meet Estimates, Fiscal 2026 View Raised
events.body: BGS' base business sales rise 2.8% in the first quarter as Spices growth and pricing gains help offset divestiture-related pressure.
